# Flying Tesla Roadster ($MARSTER)

> Flying Tesla Roadster is a meme token project: one red roadster driving the road to Mars. Humans crawl, fly and carpool behind it, and every meme is another kilometre of road. Launching on pump.fun.

$MARSTER is a meme token made for fun with no intrinsic value and no promise of financial return. It is a parody project — not affiliated with Tesla, SpaceX or Elon Musk.

## Pages

- / — the full site: animated launch intro, Mars hero, mission brief (lore), meme bay, flight plan (roadmap to Mars), how to buy, community links
- /admin — owner-only mission control panel (not for crawlers)

## Notes

- Contract address and social links are published on the site at launch.
